role: Principal Systems Architect & Lead Security Engineer (Gemini 3.8)
task_summary: Implemented automatic real-time query invalidation and synchronization across instructor/faculty/student clients when proposal titles or capstone details are updated without manual browser refresh.
root_cause:
1. Redis cache keys ('project:meta:<id>', 'project:detail:<id>') had a 120s TTL and were never evicted by projectTitle.service.js upon saving or updating proposals.
2. No Socket.IO 'project:updated' events were emitted by projectTitle.service.js.
3. useSocket.js had no listener for 'project:updated' to invalidate React Query caches across open tabs.
4. CreateProjectPage.jsx handleSaveProposalDraft called updateTitle without invalidating client queries.
5. ProjectDetailPage.jsx did not join the project defense room.
modifications: server/modules/projects/services/projectTitle.service.js: Added _invalidateProjectCache and _broadcastProjectUpdate emitting 'project:updated' to room and all clients across updateTitle, submitTitle, approveTitle, rejectTitle, addTitleComment, reviseAndResubmit, requestTitleModification, resolveTitleModification, evaluatePostApprovalUnlocks.
server/modules/projects/services/projectCore.service.js: Enhanced _invalidateProjectCache to emit 'project:updated' to room and all clients.
server/modules/projects/services/projectCommittee.service.js: Enhanced _invalidateProjectCache to emit 'project:updated' to room and all clients on adviser/panelist/secretary assignment and removal.
client/src/hooks/useSocket.js: Added handleProjectUpdated listener for 'project:updated' to invalidate projectKeys.detail, projectKeys.lists, projectKeys.my, and projectKeys.all in real-time.
client/src/pages/projects/ProjectDetailPage.jsx: Joined 'project:<projectId>' room on mount and left on unmount via getSocket().
client/src/pages/projects/CreateProjectPage.jsx: Injected QueryClientContext and safely invalidated project query caches upon proposal draft save.
client/src/hooks/useSocket.test.jsx: Added unit test verifying real-time project query invalidation and cleanup.
server/tests/unit/projectTitleRealtimeUpdates.test.js: Added unit test verifying Redis cache eviction and socket broadcast.

verification.client_targeted_tests: CreateProjectPage.test.jsx (19/19 passed), ProjectDetailPage.back-nav.test.jsx (2/2 passed), useSocket.test.jsx (2/2 passed)
